audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows gave Ziggs or Skill while the mirror — and this page's own logic about Counter Strike — put the lane in Jax's hands from level 2 to first item.
audit.why: The mirror set rows 1 through 5 to Jax across both layers as one atomic group and dropped the overall difficulty, on the grounds that a 'Hard' label cannot sit above a chart Jax wins five rows of. Level 1 stays yours on range; 2+ items is yours because Mega Inferno Bomb makes you a map problem rather than a lane one.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Jax on both layers with ratings rebuilt, and diffRating plus both difficulty lines brought down to 4/10 so the label and the chart agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why described a Ziggs spike, including the rows that belong to Jax, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Leap Strike is 8s down to 6s at 700 range for 50 mana. Empower 7s down to 3s. Counter Strike 17/15/13/11/9s at 300 — by rank 4 it is back faster than your Satchel Charge, which is 20s at rank 1. Grandmaster-at-Arms is 110/100/90s and raises his armour and MR. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120s at rank 1 at 5000 range.
audit.corrected: Each flipped row's why now names the ability and cooldown that makes it his, and the 20s-versus-11s comparison is stated in the mid plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike was treated as a blanket 'hold your damage' window, and Empower's auto reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text is that Counter Strike dodges all incoming attacks — basic attacks — then stuns. It does not stop abilities, so Bouncing Bomb and Hexplosive Minefield both land through it. 'Hold your damage until it ends' is right for autos and wrong for your whole kit, which is most of your damage. Empower is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell that the all-in has started. And Grandmaster-at-Arms raises both resistances, so a full rotation into an active R does far less than the page implies.
audit.corrected: The attacks-only scope of Counter Strike stated, the Empower reset added as the burst tell, and the resistance boost noted where it changes the burst maths.

edits.after: You only reclaim it at full items, where Mega Inferno Bomb — 120s at rank 1, 5000 range — makes you a map problem instead of a lane one. Never duel him in a side bush.

notes: The chart-versus-prose split here matched what the mirror found: five rows said Ziggs or Skill while the prose said Jax owns the lane from level 2. The most useful correction is scope on Counter Strike — it dodges attacks, so your bombs and mines land through it, and the old 'hold your damage until it ends' line was telling you to stop doing the thing that works. spikes[2].text names Luden's or Liandry's while report[8].t builds Blackfire Torch; I left the item text alone rather than guess which build is current. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockup interrupts an active Counter Strike, and whether Short Fuse's armed auto is consumed by the dodge.
